title: OPEC Monthly Oil Market Report (October 2026)
source: EST: a search index naming Tuesday 13 October 2026 as the release (re-read 2026-10-06 at initial research; still a snippet, not a primary string off a page). The cadence it rides is primary-documented: OPEC's own August 2026 MOMR (www.opec.org/assets/assetdb/momr-august-2026.pdf, HTTP 200 again on 2026-10-06 after 302ing on 2026-09-15; content stream read directly) prints verbatim 'Next report to be issued on 10 September 2026', and opec-momr-2026-09-10's own source chains 19 editions where each report's 'next report' line equals the following cover date; the 2025 edition of this month landed on 13 Oct. The September 2026 PDF that would date October is still 302 to /404.html (momr-september-2026.pdf and four naming variants, checked 2026-10-06); the appendix workbook momr-appendix-sep-2026.xlsx serves 200 but carries no 'next report' string. investing.com's calendar row is frozen on the already-published 10 Sep edition. STAYS ESTIMATE: no OPEC: confirmed prefix exists in market-events-data.ts, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Discovered 2026-10-06 by the iea-omr-2026-10-14 D-8 pulse adjacency sweep; initial research 2026-10-06
notes: The producer-side read one day before the IEA's October OMR and eight days after the 2026-10-04 OPEC+ meeting held November quotas flat. Filed low on the same reasoning as opec-momr-2026-09-10, eia-steo-2026-10-06 and iea-omr-2026-10-14: a forecast publication sets no policy and moves no equity tape. It matters to the iea-omr-2026-10-14 ledger only as a third September-month Gulf supply figure beside the EIA STEO and the IEA OMR, and it prints the day before CPI (2026-10-14) so a crude move on 10-13 is not attributable to it alone. Read after the fact, never a scheduled catalyst. Initial research 2026-10-06: docs/research/events/opec-momr-2026-10-13.md — the call is stand aside; the release lands ~08:00 ET, 24.5h before CPI, and the September edition's 12Z bar was contaminated by Hormuz news, so the tape base rate is untested rather than quiet.
